scope: Standalone real World/native exclusive worker and main-thread Rapier rehearsal; no ordinary Workbench integration claim; native514 reused locally for iteration only

findings.title: A second precommit cancellation bypasses a failed receipt-deadline hold and advances actual Rapier
findings.repro: Real active shard plus second PreparedForReview component; cancel, remove actual successful Cancelled receipt, queue one ordinary edit before timeout, expire only pending timestamp past15000000usec, poll(false), cancel_prepared again, poll actual receipts.
findings.observed: Held becomes Idle while failed remains true; Rapier steps4->8, bodyy39.0230178833->39.0893707275, vy2.5999999046->5.1999983788; completed1->2/publication19->21. Queued Action17 then executes after failed hold: World(30,20) Empty->Wood and native World Wood16->17.
findings.expected: Failed/Held is monotonic until explicit reset or close; all other mutation/continuation controls refuse without further native/physics or publication.

findings.title: A lost reset receipt makes the advertised reset recovery use a retired native session
findings.repro: Real Wood edit, reset, remove actual accepted reset receipt; expire pending timestamp and poll(false); retry reset and submit the late exact receipt.
findings.observed: Native session2 disposed prior Wood1; hostsession1 Held; retry reset StaleTransportIdentity; late receipt HeldUntilExplicitReset. close safely recovers.
findings.expected: An explicit recovery path reconciles unresolved reset identity or visibly requires close/reopen; never silently adopts uncertain state.

findings.title: Admitted queued action identities are dropped by reset without terminal dispositions
findings.repro: Queue three ordinary Wood edits and receive ActionQueued IDs1,2,3; reset before dispatch; await actual new-session receipt.
findings.observed: Action queue empty, action_results empty, last_action empty, no per-action terminal cancellation result; contract says every admitted action terminal.
findings.expected: Retain or capture a bounded per-action cancellation/retirement disposition, distinguishing queued from unresolved-inflight, or narrow the completion contract explicitly.
